scope: Borrowed parser heap handoff in dictionary-database.js; no settings, format, or native binary changes.
ordering: Parser worker publishes copied row/key/media columns and a borrowed shared glossary span, then waits for its consume callback.
Database resolves deduplication, stages signatures, starts shared compression/persistence, and obtains fixed metadata reservations.
Database synchronously publishes resolved references, metadata and any retained-source cache copy, then prepares and starts record append.
Only a real releaseBorrowedContent callback enables early handoff. sourceConsumed confirms every compressor has gathered its input.
Handoff first replaces registry contentSpans/contentBytes with the already-started persistence completion promise, then calls consume idempotently.
Raw source comparisons before handoff are synchronous. After handoff, scalar/batched exact verification and public content reads await persistence and use exact persisted bytes.
Ordered sink still joins content persistence, record append and source-release processing before accepting the next sink group.
Failures drain started operations before metadata/plan rollback. Terminal cleanup unregisters reservations and releases the borrowed source idempotently.
noDependencyCycle: Parser can begin the next group while writes finish. It cannot begin the next ordered database sink before the current one completes. Waiting readers await independent, already-started persistence, not another parser or sink operation.
regressionCoverage: shared source overwritten immediately after release
exact duplicate and deliberate hash collision
record-append failure while persistence remains pending
duplicate reservation rejection after source handoff
review: Independent VNDB agent completed a static lifecycle review with no blocker; it did not independently rerun the 150 tests.
performanceLimit: Controlled lifetime tests establish the overlap boundary and byte safety. Browser elapsed time and peak memory remain unqualified.
